name: Kala Chana and Sweet Potato Breakfast Bowl
ingredients: 150 g sweet potato, cubed and steamed
steps: Steam sweet potato cubes until just tender, about 8–10 minutes; cool slightly.
Warm cooked kala chana in a small pan with a splash of water, cumin and chaat masala.
Divide chana and sweet potato between two bowls.
Add cucumber, tomato, lemon and coriander.
Top with pumpkin seeds and serve warm or at room temperature.
note: Cooked kala chana can be batch-prepared and refrigerated promptly. No nuts or dairy.
